definition: a narrow passage for water to flow
description: A narrow stone water channel runs straight through an olive grove in warm evening light. On the left a wooden sluice gate on a metal post stands open, and brown water gushes through the opening, foaming and swirling along the channel between the two stone walls and carrying dry leaves with it. The water spreads and rises over the channel floor. A small wooden footbridge crosses the channel further along, dust hangs in the low sun and the ground in front is dry and cracked.
